description: In repos/activity-api/src/lib/posterior-update.ts, make three coordinated edits so that an execution whose trace metadata reports information_yield "idle" does not receive positive alpha credit. Edit 1: the interface TraceForPosterior beginning at line 48 has no metadata field at all, which is why this change cannot be made without it — add an optional property metadata?: { information_yield?: string } to that interface. Edit 2: line 241 currently reads exactly:   skipped_reason?: 'all_deterministic' | 'ungraded_reach';   — add a third arm so it reads 'all_deterministic' | 'ungraded_reach' | 'idle_yield'. Edit 3: line 1069 inside applyOutcomeToPosteriors currently reads exactly:   const skipVariantUpdate = tierClass === 'all_deterministic';   — the parameter named trace is in scope there; extend this so the variant_performance_metrics UPDATE is also skipped when trace.metadata?.information_yield === 'idle', and set skipped_reason to 'idle_yield' for that case in the UpdateSummary object literal at lines 1298-1310 which currently uses a nested ternary over ungraded and skipVariantUpdate. An interface-only or comment-only change is explicitly NOT sufficient — a previous attempt was rejected by the semantic gate for adding the union arm without the logic. The metadata field is optional, so when a caller does not supply it the value is undefined and behaviour is unchanged; that is intended for this change.
